step_1_which_permits_actually_exist.permit_finding: EXACTLY ONE permit exists. It is `dec0de00-0006-4000-8000-000000000001`. There is NO row with `077a6fdd-2167-559c-b2ff-8e3c8352504d` — not a different state, not a soft-deleted row: the table has one row and it is not that one.
step_1_which_permits_actually_exist.query_receipts: SELECT receipt_id::string, permit_id::string, subject_kind::string, issued_at::string, expires_at::string, (expires_at > now()) AS live FROM mainline.exposure_receipt ORDER BY receipt_id
step_1_which_permits_actually_exist.receipt_finding: The exposure receipt expires `2027-01-01 00:00:00+00`, which is exactly what `verticals/mainline/db/seeds/demo/demo_permit.sql:226-243` promises and comments as STAGED. `expires_at > now()` evaluates TRUE on the server. `scenario._RECEIPT_SQL` requires a live receipt to resolve `receipt_id`, and `gate_run.py:541` skips beat 4 (the admission) without one. The Cloud demo is therefore NOT exposed to the two-hour-TTL time bomb that plan2 §3 records against the local fixtures. THIS IS NOT A SECOND BLOCKER.
